# 8.css

> A CSS-only Windows 8 Modern UI library, with a custom Metro-style SVG icon set.

## Source layout
- `gui/*.css`: maintained CSS modules.
- `icons/icons.svg`: source vector sprite.
- `src/8.css`: generated combined stylesheet.
- `dist/8.css`: complete distribution bundle.
- `dist/gui/*.css`: modular stylesheet distribution.
- `dist/icons.svg`: separate vector sprite with 50 symbols.
- `docs/index.html`: component catalog, previews, and icon gallery.
- `AGENTS.md` and `llms-full.txt`: maintainer and agent guidance.

## Principles
- Keep Windows 8 Start Screen and desktop UI recognizable, using flat surfaces and solid color.
- Use `w8-` class names to reduce collisions.
- Keep runtime CSS-only; SVG icons are loaded as a static sprite, without JavaScript.
- Use semantic HTML, visible focus, accessible labels, and reduced-motion support.
- Do not claim CSS implements application state, keyboard navigation, or window behavior.

## Package
Install with `npm install @flessan/8.css`, then import `@flessan/8.css`. For plain HTML, use `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/8.css`. The SVG icon sprite is available separately at `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/icons.svg`.
